$comment: App identity of the Grindr flavor (FG_FLAVOR=grindr, the default). Read by scripts/flavor.mjs. These values are the ones the app shipped with before flavors existed; changing identifier or android.applicationId turns the app into a different one (no in-place update, separate data).

windows.$comment: Tauri derives the default from productName; pinned so a rename doesn't break MSI upgrades (`bunx tauri inspect wix-upgrade-code`).
